# HaveItAll.lk
> Sri Lanka's trusted online store for 100% authentic global skincare, health supplements, cosmetics, and beauty appliances with islandwide Cash on Delivery.

## Main Catalog Departments
- [Skincare & Cosmetics](https://haveitall.lk/cosmetics): 100% authentic face serums, sunscreens, moisturizers, cleansers, and lip care in Sri Lanka.
- [Health Supplements](https://haveitall.lk/shop): Verified glutathione tablets, hair growth vitamins, and daily wellness nutrition.
- [Beauty Appliances](https://haveitall.lk/appliances): Authentic trimmers, shavers, and personal grooming appliances.
- [Fashion & Lifestyle](https://haveitall.lk/fashion): Men's and women's curated accessories, watches, and apparel.
- [Brand Stockists Directory](https://haveitall.lk/brands): Verified authentic brand portfolio including Foxtale, Pilgrim, UV Doux, Chicnutrix, Woodoo, and Reginald.

- [Moisturizers](https://haveitall.lk/category/moisturizers): Hydrating barrier creams, gel moisturizers, and night creams.
